Ragi malt- Ingredients- 2-3 tbsp ragi flour Milk of your choice 1 tbsp jaggery powder Cardamom powder Ginger powder Nutmeg powder Process- Take 2-3 tbsp of ragi flour, add water to it & mix well. Then take a pan, add water to it & let it boil. After it starts boiling, add the ragi mixture to it & cook till it thickens & becomes glossyTo that then add jaggery powder, cardamom powder, ginger powder & nutmeg.
